class twin.actionable_parameters.ActionableParameters(config_path: str | None = None)

The 5 key parameters that control virtual twin behavior These serve as proxies for real-world operational improvements

Configuration is REQUIRED - all parameter definitions must come from config

Initialize actionable parameters from configuration. Configuration is required - will raise error if not available.

Parameters:

config_path – Optional path to JSON config file for parameter definitions. If not provided, will use ConfigLoader.

current_values: Dict[str, float]
set_value(parameter_name: str, value: float) → None

Set the value of a parameter with validation

Parameters:

  • parameter_name – Name of the parameter to set

  • value – New value for the parameter

Raises:

  • KeyError – If parameter_name is not recognized

  • ValueError – If value is outside valid bounds
